doc.title: Bill Holman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999

title: His first records as a leader
summary: He lists his 1954 octet, Coral, Orbit and Great Big Band albums.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Yeah, 1960, “Bill Holman’s Great Big Band.” Was “Big Band In Jazz Orbit” ’58, was that one of your first records under your own name?

That was the second one. Well I did an octet record for that “Kenton Presents” series in 1954, but that was the second big band thing. I did one for a company called Coral, which was a subsidiary of Decca in 1956 or 7, ’57 I guess. And Orbit was ’58 and the “Great Big Band” was 1960.
